question: Will a US senator die before October 1st?
resolution_criteria:
Resolution criteria

This market will resolve to YES if any currently serving United States Senator dies between the creation of this market and October 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM Eastern Time. Otherwise, this market will resolve to NO.

Currently serving U.S. Senator: An individual who is an active, sworn member of the United States Senate at the time of their death. Former senators, senators-elect who have not yet been sworn in, and members of the House of Representatives do not qualify.

Timing of death: The death must be officially confirmed to have occurred before October 1, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET. If a death occurs prior to this deadline but is only publicly announced or confirmed after October 1, the market will still resolve to YES.

Verification: Resolution will be determined by official U.S. Senate vacancy announcements (via senate.gov) or consensus reporting from major reputable news organizations (e.g., AP News, Reuters).

Background

The U.S. Senate has a historically high average age, with a median age of 64 at the start of the 119th Congress. Several sitting members are octogenarians or nonagenarians, including Chuck Grassley (92), Bernie Sanders (84), and Mitch McConnell (83).

Most recently, Senator Lindsey Graham (R-SC) passed away in office on July 11, 2026, at the age of 71. His passing marked the sixth death of a sitting member of the 119th Congress. This market tracks whether another active U.S. Senator will pass away before October 1, 2026.

I found no reports that a sitting US senator died between July 11 and September 28, 2026. Only about 3.5 days are left before the deadline (October 1, 11:59 PM ET), and I found no report of a sitting senator being critically ill.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria name senate.gov vacancy announcements or consensus reporting from AP or Reuters. They give no specific URL, and I did not fetch senate.gov. Several pages, including Wikipedia and Ballotpedia, refused the connection, so I relied on search results.
- 2026-07-13: Ballotpedia said the Senate was 52 Republicans, 45 Democrats and one vacancy after Graham's death. [Ballotpedia](https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/07/13/lindsey-graham-becomes-the-fourth-member-of-the-u-s-senate-since-2013-to-die-while-in-office/)
- 2026-09-14: CNBC and CNN said Republicans hold 53-47. That suggests Graham's seat has been filled by appointment. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/14/mitch-mcconnell-returns-senate-capitol-health-fall.html)

## 2. Current status
- I found no death of a sitting US senator from July 12 through September 28, 2026. The September 2026 deaths I found were former senators or senators from other countries.
- 2026-09-17: Former Senator Jon Kyl (R-AZ) died at 84. He was not serving, so his death does not count. [Washington Post](https://www.washingtonpost.com/obituaries/2026/09/17/jon-kyl-former-top-republican-senate-dies-84/)
- The other September deaths were former senators of Italy and Liberia and several US state senators, none of which count. [Wikipedia: Deaths in September 2026](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Deaths_in_September_2026)
- The question's background is correct: Sen. Lindsey Graham died in office on 2026-07-11. The preliminary cause was an aortic dissection. [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/senator-lindsey-graham-dies-after-brief-and-sudden-illness/), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/12/nx-s1-5890790/us-sen-lindsey-graham-dies)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-28: ABC News reported that Sen. Chuck Grassley, who turned 93 on September 17, said at a GOP dinner that he does not plan to die in office. I found no September health problem for him. His last medical news was gallstone surgery in April 2026. [KTTC](https://www.kttc.com/2026/04/21/iowa-senator-chuck-grassley-recovering-home-after-weekend-surgery/)
- 2026-09-17: Salon ran a commentary on McConnell's return to the Senate. [Salon](https://www.salon.com/2026/09/17/mitch-mcconnell-is-back-and-its-terrifying/)
- 2026-09-14: Sen. Mitch McConnell (84) returned to the Senate after about three months away.
  - He was hospitalized June 14 after a fall, then had mild pneumonia and time in rehab. He was discharged August 6.
  - He said he is "still not quite back to 100%." Reporters said he looked thinner and spoke more slowly.
  - His physician said he has had several falls this year, linked to his post-polio condition.
  - He is not running again and leaves office in January. [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/09/14/nx-s1-5968909/mitch-mcconnell-senate-return), [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/14/politics/mitch-mcconnell-senate-return-health), [ABC News](https://abcnews.com/Politics/sen-mitch-mcconnell-announces-return-senate-after-hospitalization/story?id=136437773)
- 2026-02-04: McConnell was hospitalized with flu-like symptoms. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/02/04/mitch-mcconnell-hospitalized-flu-senate)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-07-13: Ballotpedia said Graham was the fourth senator to die in office since 2013. The others were Lautenberg (2013), McCain (2018) and Feinstein (2023). That is about 4 deaths in 13.5 years, or roughly 0.3 per year. [Ballotpedia](https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/07/13/lindsey-graham-becomes-the-fourth-member-of-the-u-s-senate-since-2013-to-die-while-in-office/)
- My own calculation, assuming deaths happen at random: 0.3 per year over a 3.5-day window gives about a 0.3% chance. Even double that rate gives under 1%.
- 2026-07-15: US News has a historical overview of senators who died in office. [US News](https://www.usnews.com/news/national-news/articles/2026-07-15/how-many-u-s-senators-have-died-in-office)
- The "sixth death in the 119th Congress" figure in the background counts House members too. It is not a Senate-only number.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Manifold has a play-money market on this exact question, "Will a US senator die before October…". I could not load the page, so I don't have its current probability or creation date. The creation date matters because the window starts when the market was created. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/OnlySlides/will-a-us-senator-die-before-octobe)
- Kalshi has a related market on Sen. Ruben Gallego leaving office before Oct 1. It traded around 8-9% in July snapshots, on very thin volume of about $1K. Leaving office for any reason is a different event from dying. [SimpleFunctions](https://simplefunctions.dev/markets/will-ruben-gallego-be-out-as-senator-before-oct-1-kalshi-kxgallegoout-26oct01)
- I found no Polymarket market on a senator dying.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- The window is short: September 28 to October 1, 11:59 PM ET.
- I found no reports of a sitting senator currently in hospital or critically ill.
- The senators with the most visible risk are McConnell (84, frail, history of falls) and Grassley (93). Both were active as of mid-to-late September.
- A death that happens before the deadline but is announced later still counts YES. Check AP or Reuters and senate.gov for any announcement through about October 2.
